evidence.reason: The fixture creates real git commits at lines 94 and 99 but never disables inherited signing. A repository-local `commit.gpgSign=false` (or `git -c commit.gpgSign=false commit`) is the standard minimal test-isolation fix; without it, a developer/CI environment with global `commit.gpgSign=true` and no key matching the fixture identity makes the first commit fail and errors every DeployTests case in setUp. This is an ordinary test-correctness defect, not a request to add a new contract requirement.
